messages:
elaine.w: Quick question — for long-running streaming requests (large context/model warm), would we prefer an early-ack from edge so client sees the connection established while we allocate runtime, or hold until runtime is ready?

sam.k: Early-ack helps client UX (native SDKs show spinner vs immediate error). But it complicates retries + idempotency. If we ack, client may assume delivery and retry on timeout, causing duplicate execution.

aditya.m: Agree. Proposal: support two modes via header `x-redwood-edge-ack: early | ready`. Default `ready` (no ack until runtime ready). Early allowed only for idempotent calls (no side effects) and when idempotency-key provided.

iris: How do we enforce idempotency at the edge? Suggest token-based dedupe + `x-rw-idempotency-key`. Also runtime should reject early-ack mode if model variant not pinned or if warm estimate > 5s.

ops-bot: CI: added tests for `x-redwood-edge-ack` header handling — build #1287 passed ✅

sam.k: If we do early ack we need to surface a clear client-visible state via `x-rw-edge-state: warming|active|failed` and include trailers at stream end with final HTTP/gRPC status so SDKs can reconcile.

elaine.w: Also need explicit retry semantics in docs: clients must not retry idempotent requests until the connection is closed or a non-retryable status is returned. If they reconnect, server must consult `x-rw-idempotency-key` to avoid duplicate work.

aditya.m: Draft config snippet for ops:
```
edge:
  admit_window: 250ms
  early_ack:
    enabled: true
    allowed_for: ["completion","embeddings"]
  retry_on: [503, 504]
  idempotency_header: "x-rw-idempotency-key"
  state_header: "x-rw-edge-state"
```

iris: Ops concern — early ack will increase open connection counts during warmups. Need admission control + per-tenant concurrency quotas to avoid thundering herd. Suggest per-tenant queue with token-bucket and a `queue-timeout` that maps to `x-rw-edge-state: rejected`.

sam.k: For streaming partial outputs we can send a lightweight heartbeat chunk before the first real tokens so the client sees progress without committing output. Propose control frame `:heartbeat` (opaque) that SDKs ignore as content.

elaine.w: Action items: (1) aditya to draft RFC for header/state probes & server semantics, (2) infra to model load impact with early-ack toggle, (3) SDKs to add idempotency-key helper + `x-rw-edge-state` mapping. Sync tomorrow 11:00. :calendar:

aditya.m: RFC WIP: https://redwood-internal/notes/rfc/edge-early-ack (will add benchmarks + unit tests).

mike.p: +1 to the draft. One more note — fallback behavior: if runtime rejects early ack attempt (e.g., overcommitted), edge should respond 409 with `x-rw-reason: runtime-unavailable` so client can either back off or retry with `ready` mode.

sam.k: 👍
